name: Photon target protection and temporary sector defense suppression

tests.name: Create ordinary photon shooter
Create ordinary sector entrant
Create ordinary photon target
Rig adjacent sectors

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps(from_sector,to_sector) VALUES(1,679),(679,1),(1,680),(680,1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Position photon participants

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1 WHERE player_id IN (@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},@{photon_suppression_victim_player_id},@{photon_suppression_target_player_id});

tests.name: Prepare eligible photon ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE,hull=100,shields=0,fighters=0,photons=3,type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate') WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id});

tests.name: Prepare ordinary entering ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE,hull=100,shields=0,fighters=12 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_victim_player_id});

tests.name: Move target owner before its ship to shield test sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=680 WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_target_player_id};

tests.name: Prepare shielded-planet photon target ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=680,onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE,hull=100,shields=10,fighters=12,combat_disabled_until=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_target_player_id});

tests.name: Save target and shooter ship IDs

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_target_player_id}),(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id});

tests.name: Clear old sector assets

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679;

tests.name: Place hostile Armid mine and fighter

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,ttl) VALUES(679,@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},0,1,1,0,0),(679,@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},0,2,1,1,0);

tests.name: Create planet with active citadel reaction

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,created_by,population,population_type,colonists_unassigned,fighters) VALUES(987655,679,'Photon Suppression Citadel',@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},'player',@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},100,'COLONIST',100,10);

tests.name: Select an ordinary active StarPort for disabled-attack coverage

data.sql: SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE is_active=TRUE ORDER BY port_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Place the test StarPort in the photon target sector

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET sector_id=679,durability=10000,defensive_strength=1000 WHERE port_id=@{photon_test_port_id};

tests.name: Configure citadel reaction multiplier

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels(planet_id,level,militaryReactionLevel,planetaryShields) VALUES(987655,2,2,0);

tests.name: Create shielded planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,created_by,population) VALUES(987654,680,'Photon Shield Test',@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},'player',@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id},0);

tests.name: Create planetary shield

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels(planet_id,level,planetaryShields) VALUES(987654,5,1);

tests.name: Prepare second approved photon ship class

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Imperial Starship') WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id});

tests.name: Imperial Starship passes class check but planetary shield blocks launch
Second eligible class shield refusal does not spend photon

data.sql: SELECT s.photons=3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=680) FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id};

tests.name: Temporarily equip an ineligible ship class

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Merchant Cruiser') WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id});

tests.name: Ineligible ship class cannot fire photons
Ineligible attempt preserves ammo and effect state

data.sql: SELECT s.photons=3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=679) FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id};

tests.name: Restore eligible photon ship class

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate') WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id});

tests.name: Move target owner before its ship to adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=679 WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_target_player_id};

tests.name: Place direct target in adjacent firing sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=679,shields=10,combat_disabled_until=0 WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Planetary shield refuses photon impact
Shield refusal preserves ammunition and creates no effect

data.sql: SELECT s.photons=2 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=680) FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id};

tests.name: Shielded ship consumes one photon and sector suppression still applies
Shielded direct target remains enabled while sector suppression persists

data.sql: SELECT s.photons=2 AND s.combat_disabled_until=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=679 AND expires_at>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint) FROM ships s WHERE s.ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Remove ship shields for direct impact acceptance

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET shields=0 WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Unshielded target receives combat disablement
Photon disablement is persisted through authoritative ship status
Photon-disabled ship cannot initiate a ship attack

expect.message: Photon-disabled combat systems cannot initiate attacks or fire weapons

tests.name: Photon-disabled ship cannot initiate a planetary attack

expect.message: Photon-disabled combat systems cannot initiate attacks or fire weapons

tests.name: Photon-disabled ship cannot initiate a StarPort attack

expect.message: Photon-disabled combat systems cannot initiate attacks or fire weapons

tests.name: Equip disabled target with a photon without changing its effect

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate'),photons=1 WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Photon-disabled ship cannot fire another weapon

expect.message: Photon-disabled combat systems cannot initiate attacks or fire weapons

tests.name: Disabled weapon refusal preserves ammunition and creates no shot receipt

data.sql: SELECT s.photons=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE request_id='photon-disabled-cannot-refire-001') FROM ships s WHERE s.ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Photon-disabled ship retains non-combat status access
Photon-disabled ship retains navigation
Entrant has undamaged baseline
Active photon permits arrival without resolving armed fighter
Suppressed arrival preserves hull and defense asset

data.sql: SELECT s.hull=100 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id} AND asset_type IN (1,2))=2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=679 AND expires_at>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint) FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{photon_suppression_victim_player_id};

tests.name: Attack citadel during photon effect
Photon suppresses reaction without changing stored citadel configuration

data.sql: SELECT p.owner_id=@{photon_suppression_victim_player_id} AND c.militaryReactionLevel=2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=679 AND expires_at>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint) FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE p.planet_id=987655;

tests.name: Expire the persisted effect through disposable test fixture

data.sql: UPDATE sector_photon_effects SET expires_at=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1 WHERE sector_id=679;

tests.name: Entrant leaves after suppression expiry
Expired effect no longer suppresses armed defense
Post-expiry defense engages and consumes its one fighter asset

data.sql: SELECT s.hull<100 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id=679 AND owner_id=@{photon_suppression_shooter_player_id} AND asset_type IN (1,2)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE actor_player_id=@{photon_suppression_victim_player_id} AND type='combat.hit.fighters') FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{photon_suppression_victim_player_id};

tests.name: Photon shooter enters the target sector after defenses are consumed
Reset disabled player's location before expiry recovery

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1 WHERE player_id=@{photon_suppression_target_player_id};

tests.name: Reset disabled ship location before expiry recovery

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1 WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Expire direct ship disablement without cleanup

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET combat_disabled_until=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1 WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id};

tests.name: Disabled player can navigate after direct effect expiry
Expired direct disablement no longer blocks combat
